title.zh: 两种寄存器各记一件事

brief.zh: 看累加器怎么保留计算结果，程序计数器怎么准备下一步。
brief.en: Watch the accumulator hold a working value and the program counter prepare the next step.

concept.zh: ACC 保存计算中的值，PC 指向下一条指令。
concept.en: ACC holds the working value and PC points to the next instruction.

body.zh: LOAD 用读到的值替换 ACC。ADD 和 SUB 修改 ACC 里的数。要把这份工作结果留在内存里，再使用 STORE。
body.en: LOAD replaces ACC with a value from memory. ADD and SUB change the value in ACC. Use STORE when you want to keep that result in memory.

title.zh: PC 记下程序走到哪儿
title.en: PC keeps the place in the program

body.zh: 程序计数器 PC 从 0 开始。每执行一条指令，PC 前进一格，准备下一条。ACC 可以变大、变小，也可以保持原值。
body.en: The program counter, PC, starts at 0. Each executed instruction advances it by one. ACC can go up, go down, or stay the same.

caption.zh: 开始时 ACC 里有 5，PC 指向第 0 条指令 ADD 0。地址 0 里是 6。
caption.en: ACC holds 5 and PC points to instruction 0, ADD 0. Address 0 contains 6.

caption.zh: 刚执行 ADD 0，ACC 成为 11。PC 指向 SUB 1。地址 1 里是 3。
caption.en: ADD 0 made ACC 11. PC points to SUB 1, and address 1 contains 3.

caption.zh: 刚执行 SUB 1，ACC 变小了，PC 仍然向前走了一格。
caption.en: SUB 1 lowered ACC, while PC still moved forward by one.

caption.zh: 执行 HALT，ACC 保留最后算出的 8。PC 前进一步，CPU 停止取指。
caption.en: HALT leaves the final value, 8, in ACC. PC advances once and the CPU stops fetching instructions.

prompt.zh: 执行 SUB 让 ACC 从 11 变成 8。PC 会怎么变？
prompt.en: SUB changes ACC from 11 to 8. What happens to PC?

feedback.zh: SUB 只减 ACC；PC 负责指向下一条指令。
feedback.en: SUB subtracts from ACC. PC moves on to the next instruction.
